answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The sonnet of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, published publicly on failure, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Each submission hangs on the trellis of a task receipt, and the wharf is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
